name: Athreos
description: Athreos is a Theran god, the River Guide, who helps the dead pass into the Underworld.

bio.text: Athreos helps the dead pass into the Underworld, the place from which the Returned escaped, and the Returned are counted as his allies.
Leandros prays to Athreos for the dead as his squad moves on without burying them.

citations.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

bio.text: Ravos strikes a deal with Athreos to guide the dead in exchange for yearly visits with his lover, and serves as his oracle.

timeline.summary: Leandros prays to Athreos for the dead as the squad moves on without burying them.
timeline.quote: Leandros muttered a prayer to Athreos, who ferried souls to the Underworld

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Ravos strikes a deal with Athreos to guide the dead in exchange for yearly visits with his lover.
timeline.quote: Ravos swore to help Athreos guide the dead to the Underworld in exchange for seeing his dead lover once each year.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld; despite Karametra's efforts Athreos seizes the boy, and Lidia offers herself in his place and is taken instead.
timeline.quote: Lidia offered herself in her son's place and was taken to the Underworld instead.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Athreos becomes inactive, souls cannot be ferried, and Returned accumulate outside the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos, like the other deities of Theros, became inactive.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, Athreos shatters Kroxa's chains so it can destroy the Phyrexians in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos shattered the chains that bound the titan, allowing it to lay waste to the Phyrexian forces.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Athreos sends Kunoros to accompany and restrain Kroxa so it cannot escape the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos sent his hound, Kunoros , to accompany and restrain the titan during its rampage.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lidia takes Daxos to Athreos; he speaks and is revealed to be an oracle; Erebos sends Athreos to claim him.
timeline.quote: Athreos was sent to claim the child

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lidia trades herself for her son and Karametra's emissary takes Daxos to safety.
timeline.quote: Lidia traded herself for her son

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to fetch Daxos for his oracular gift; Lidia takes her son's place and is brought to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: thus she was brought to the Underworld while Daxos was left alone in the Mortal Realm.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The squad finds Eumalos and his squad dead and headless, then is trapped by a boulderfall.
timeline.quote: They were all dead, their heads missing.

citation.text: "Leandros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the Underworld unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to escape the Underworld without drawing the notice of Athreos or Erebos

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the River of the Dead a scholar of Athreos refuses him passage until a death mask forms on his face.
timeline.quote: he felt the matter on his face shift and sculpt itself into a grimacing death mask

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos is ferried across to the Underworld to take his place among the dead.
timeline.quote: the ancient barge silently slid forth from the fog

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Originally a mortal trapped in the Underworld, Phenax hides from Erebos and Athreos by forsaking his identity and crosses back wrapped in Athreos's cloak, becoming the first Returned.
timeline.quote: This escape established his role as the first Returned and set him on the path to godhood.

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
